limitations: This frozen proof identifies reviewed source premises; it is not a native execution receipt, a caller Boolean attestation, or qualification by itself.
The prelaunch digest is distinct from the final archive digest. Fresh process observations must satisfy all ten premises under the admitted build.
The unchanged warm-v1 reader remains blocked; four-process qualification does not establish the complete warm experiment, performance acceptance, FPGA operation or silicon behavior.

premises.runtime_obligation: Retain generated configuration, compile flags, loaded executable/runtime/dependency identities, environment, capabilities and exact inventories for each real process; do not infer them from a profile name.
premises.statement: Exact route and inventory: RV64 serial timing, checked PERF, p02-tfr STD topology, 33 available core-zero selectors and 12 unavailable selectors.

premises.runtime_obligation: Use an unseeded new device lifetime; record all launch/reset generations and reject any checked failure. Type assignment/subtraction support alone does not establish monotonicity.
premises.statement: All 40 selected backing components are zero at construction and undergo only nonnegative additions on the admitted production route.

premises.runtime_obligation: Before each direct-RAM launch reset, establish drained prior work, platform idle and zero pending reads; reset cannot rescue a failed or abandoned context.
premises.statement: Permitted launch reset preserves all selected cumulative backing storage; transient balances are reconciled before reset.

premises.runtime_obligation: Successfully query every one of the 33 exact selectors at the terminal boundary; a subset or per-component check alone is insufficient.
premises.statement: The final aggregate is evaluated with checked additions from zero before uint64 conversion; every component and every partial sum must fit.

premises.runtime_obligation: Retain operation/event completion statuses and actual queue destruction/join and final owner-reference observations. Public release success alone is insufficient.
premises.statement: Every operation queue has actually been destroyed and joined; no retained owner can submit later work.

premises.runtime_obligation: Establish successful execution, collected async run, zero pending reads, platform idle, CP completion and no residual DMA or flush before the terminal vector.
premises.statement: All launch, download and cache flush activity precedes the terminal readout; processor execution is collected and all queues are idle.

premises.runtime_obligation: Exclude concurrent submitters/batches and all-core unchecked host summation. Preserve raw status and both halves, full width reconstruction, no reset/tick during observation, and success before CP disable.
premises.statement: Exclusive core-zero public low/high readout occurs while CP submission remains enabled; these MPM DCR reads do not tick the GPU model.

premises.runtime_obligation: Enter destruction only after P05-P07, with actual final reference. CP disable polling is not a replacement drain certificate; capture completion of the destructor path.
premises.statement: After the last accepted read, destruction on the VM-off/direct-RAM route has no selected-counter updater or new GPU tick.

premises.runtime_obligation: Bind the actual dependency binary to the selected source behavior; the companion source manifest alone and a cache hash do not establish compilation origin.
premises.statement: The selected dependency finalizers and statistics emitters do not tick, send or deliver a GPU callback; the adapter does not drain at destruction.

premises.runtime_obligation: Retain raw public failure/side-effect observations and independently fresh-context success. An interrupted MPM aggregate may leave mpm_class changed, so discard the failed context.
premises.statement: A checked failure invalidates the process context and its numeric evidence; no reset, later query or fresh allocation rehabilitates that same lifetime.

theorem.statement: For one accepted unseeded lifetime, each selected component is nonnegative and monotone through admitted resets, and a successful final checked aggregate at T fits uint64. Thus for every earlier t each aggregate S_j(t) <= S_j(T) <= 2^64-1. No component or aggregate can have wrapped in that lifetime. A no-update suffix extends the bound until selected storage destruction.
